adjudication.rationale: The diff rewrites `GroupsController#members` to return a new JSON envelope with `meta: { total, limit, offset }` and applies pagination to all groups (not just automatic) (`app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`). Both clients were updated to rely on this shape: `Discourse.Group#findMembers` reads `result.meta.total/limit/offset` and `result.members` (`app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`), and admin pagination computes `currentPage` as `Math.floor(offset/limit)+1` (`admin-group.js.es6`). However, this diff adds/updates specs only for `Admin::GroupsController` and does not add any controller spec covering the new `GroupsController#members` response contract (meta fields + pagination semantics). That’s a concrete, diff-grounded testing gap for newly introduced nontrivial behavior, not an immediately verifiable runtime defect.
